description: This file implements logging utilities for the hal_logger component. It defines functions for message logging at different levels, initializes and terminates logging modules, and handles configuration via environment variables and files.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_Logger_Message(eMessageLevel level,const char * function,int line,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Logs a message with a given severity level, function name, line number, and formatted message.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleInit()
methods.description: Initializes the logging module, checks for specific files or environment variables to set verbose logging.

methods.name: void HALUTIL_LogModuleTerminate()
methods.description: Terminates the logging module, logs termination message.
